items.title: CoreWeave earnings spark broad AI infrastructure rebound across memory, optics and power
items.summary: CoreWeave's earnings-driven recovery broadened to AI cloud, memory, optical networking and data-center power names on November 11. At 10:30 AM ET, an intraday market snapshot showed CRWV up 21.9%, NBIS 16.3%, BE 15.0%, SNDK 14.7% and LITE 12.7%. The broad response supports renewed AI demand confidence, but financing and capital intensity remain risks.

observations.label: Intraday observation time
observations.value: November 11, 2026 at approximately 10:30 AM EST; not closing prices

items.key_finding: AI demand repricing broadened across infrastructure suppliers; financing risks and persistence of breadth remain key tests.

sources.title: Investor's Business Daily AI infrastructure rebound coverage

items.title: Riskified surges following 41% Q3 revenue growth and higher outlook
items.summary: Riskified reported $115.2 million in Q3 revenue, up 41% year over year, and raised 2026 revenue guidance to $427–433 million. Shares traded 20.4% higher at 12:37 PM EST. Cash and deposits are strong and free cash flow positive, but gross margin narrowed sharply; merchant retention and agentic-fraud product adoption remain tests.

observations.label: Share observation
observations.value: November 11, 2026 at 12:37 PM EST; intraday, not official close

items.key_finding: Accelerating software sales and cash generation support earnings repricing, but lower gross margins and growth durability warrant scrutiny.

items.title: India identifies Fujairah Energy tanker strike and four injured crew
items.summary: India's shipping minister said a projectile struck the Liberia-flagged VLCC Fujairah Energy on November 10 while sailing between Al Ruwais and Dubai, injuring four crew. One Indian seafarer had minor injuries and the remaining 18 crew were reported safe. The incident may overlap earlier Gulf tanker warnings; cargo damage and incremental oil throughput loss remain unverified.

observations.value: Al Ruwais to Dubai, Persian Gulf

observations.label: Crew
observations.value: Four injured including one Indian national; 18 others reported safe

items.key_finding: Government identification and crew injuries confirm tangible maritime damage, while overlap with previous warnings and oil-flow impact remain unresolved.

items.title: Russian refineries representing 30% of nameplate capacity affected by drone strikes
items.summary: Reuters reported that attacks since late October have disrupted nine major Russian refineries whose combined nameplate capacity represents about 30% of national capacity. This is not a confirmed 30% fall in throughput: industry sources estimate an actual possible crude-processing reduction of up to 200,000 tonnes per day. Repair progress and fuel exports will determine the lasting physical impact.

observations.value: Reuters, November 10, 2026, 7:11 AM EST; reviewed November 11 at midday

observations.label: Affected nameplate capacity
observations.value: Approximately 300,000 metric tonnes per day (~2.2 million barrels per day); around 30% of national nameplate

observations.value: No Russia-specific Brent, WTI, XLE or XOP effect isolated

items.key_finding: Widespread refinery operating disruptions are reported, but capacity affected must not be confused with verified lost production.

items.title: UKMTO Warning 202-26 flags another unresolved Hormuz tanker incident
items.summary: Reports of UKMTO Warning 202-26 describe suspicious activity involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with military authorities as the source. The vessel, incident date and time, crew condition, damage and environmental effects are unknown. This is a separate warning from 201-26, but it is neither a confirmed attack nor a verified physical oil-flow loss.

observations.label: Classification
observations.value: Suspicious activity; not classified as confirmed attack

observations.label: Location
observations.value: Strait of Hormuz; no coordinates supplied

observations.label: Physical supply impact
observations.value: No verified interruption or lost oil volume

items.key_finding: A new numbered tanker security warning adds unresolved risk but must not be conflated with an attack or a mine claim.
